[[File:Jabba_roasting_spit.jpg|250px|thumb|Jabba's roasting spit]]
In his [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] kept a '''roasting spit''' at the back of his [[Jabba the Hutt's dais/Legends|throne]]. It consisted of a metallic table with a pattern in relief on the sides and legs. The rotisserie was supported about a [[Meter/Legends|meter]] above the flickering [[Fire/Legends|fire]].<ref name="ROJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

Huge meat pieces were put on this ornate barbeque to satisfy the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord's]] special culinary requirements. The private [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Porcellus/Legends|Porcellus]] cooked many meals on it for his [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] master, including [[sandmaggot]] kidneys<ref name="SWGTCG">{{SWGTCG|set=The Shadow Syndicate|cardname=Jabba's Roasting Spit}}</ref> and broiled [[Jerba/Legends|jerba]].<ref name="IWSW">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref>
